title: Learning Perceptual Geometry of Natural Odor Mixtures from LLM-Derived Descriptors
abstract: arXiv:2610.17164v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The relationship between odor chemistry and perception remains incompletely understood. Many existing studies focus on the perception of single molecules, whereas natural odors contain tens to hundreds of components, adding extra layer of complexity to percept formation. Here, we explore the relationship between molecular composition and perceived similarity in natural odor objects. We study this using a database of more than 1,200 volatile-compound-in-food mixtures containing more than 8,000 molecular components, and use large language models (LLMs) as a scalable surrogate for deriving mixture-level perceptual descriptions. We find that language-derived representations provide useful supervision for predicting held-out mixture similarities from molecular composition. translated_title: 从大语言模型衍生的描述符学习天然气味混合物的感知几何
translated_abstract: 气味化学与感知之间的关系仍未被完全理解。许多现有研究聚焦于单分子的感知，而天然气味包含数十到数百种成分，为知觉的形成增加了额外的复杂性层次。在这里，我们探索了天然气味对象中分子组成与感知相似性之间的关系。我们使用一个包含超过1,200种食品挥发性化合物混合物（含超过8,000个分子成分）的数据库来开展研究，并利用大语言模型（LLM）作为可扩展的替代工具来推导混合物层面的感知描述。我们发现，语言衍生的表示为从分子组成预测留出混合物的相似性提供了有效的监督信号。当感知目标来自化学感官提示而非其他感官提示时，预测效果始终最佳。此外，在混合物层面……
tldr: 该研究利用大语言模型生成的感知描述，从超过1,200种天然食品气味混合物的分子组成成功预测其感知相似性，并发现基于化学感官提示的语言表征能产生最准确的预测，从而揭示了天然气味混合物的分子组成与知觉之间的映射关系。
en_tdlr: This study uses LLM-derived perceptual descriptors to predict perceived similarity from the molecular composition of over 1,200 natural food odor mixtures, showing that representations from chemosensory prompts yield the strongest predictions and revealing the mapping between molecular composition and perception of natural odor mixtures.
